name: page-feature-completion
goal: Group Types pages by their feature and keep the generic routing host out of Pages

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: User rejects Explorer & navigation as a Pages group. Types list/detail/history belong in Types; the generic Harness route host is internal catalog infrastructure.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing module-groups/browser page-family fixture selected only nine families and omitted Types plus reports.page.harness-view. Expanded those existing fixtures and the registry classification check before product edits.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Focused Vitest command at test-only76fd0cd00 timed out before execution in normal memory-warning admission; no red proof claimed. Daniel waived paired-record/full-suite prerequisites for this delivery.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Added type-catalog route-folder taxonomy and selected-revision catalog.visibility=internal on the generic route host; kept routes and registered identities unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Focused Vitest remains unexecuted under the resource blocker. Read-only metadata smoke independently projects three Types pages, no broad group and no public routing host; it is not Vitest/browser proof.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Units registry valid:1537 units,96 uncertain references. Changed-file Prettier and diff checks pass. Shared5690 browser delivery and refreshed main history remain pending with Platforms.
